conventions.body_raw / headers: optional scenario fields (lane S2's runner): send body_raw verbatim instead of the JSON of request; headers override the runner's defaults (null removes one); the method is the route's
conventions.direct_not_run: a scenario only the MCP arm runs (v8's stop scenarios), the reason: the direct arms skip it (suite_common.plan_executions)
conventions.mcp.by_design: case ids of the async session's service-by-design table (service_by_design.json)
conventions.mcp.requires_service: the service increment the MCP mapping needs (I12: max_mismatches)
conventions.run_unique: top-level request fields the direct runner makes unique per run and arm (lane S5b, A-10; lane S5c, A2-06): it appends '-', the run id (the run directory's name, which the arms of a run share), '-' and the arm to each, cut to the id pattern's 128 characters, and records the request it sent; the manifest keeps the base value
conventions.timing_class: fast (< ~5 s), slow, long (> 100 s: direct-local only)
conventions.truth.flank: record bases around the window, starting at truth.flank_start (0-based); clipped at the record's ends and at the fetched region's ends
conventions.truth.start: 0-based position of the window's first base on the record's forward strand (whole-record coordinates)
conventions.truth.window: the record's bases on its forward strand (for a '-' source the reverse complement of the pattern)
conventions.warms: a warm-up's target (lane V5): the id of the scenario whose annotation rows it reads right before it; the builder keeps the pair adjacent (the warm-up first) and every selection that takes the target takes its warm-up (suite_common.select_scenarios)

mcp_exposure_baseline.rule: the checks decided (pass, fail or finding) on EVERY recorded MCP execution of the scenario whose status check passed (an execution with another status decides nothing, so a scenario with one has no list); written into a scenario's mcp.exposes only where its MCP request is the baseline's (a time_budget_ms aside, traverse_resolve's and pattern_search's: a budget shapes no field of the answer), restricted to the checks the scenario expects
